text:
Anya: Quick sync on Dedicated roadmap for this sprint. We have three asks: (A) customer-configurable soft headroom per pool, (B) a simple per-tenant quota visibility widget in Console, (C) an autoscale fallback that shifts heavy bursts to quantized, cheaper model variants before preemptions. Need to pick scope.
Lucas: I vote A then B. A is low-risk config work and unlocks sales. B is small UI + backend work. C is bigger (routing + quality risk).
Sara: C is non-trivial. It touches routing, model compatibility, KV cache transfer and eval gating. We'd want a research spike first.
Devin: Sales input: BrightCard wants guaranteed burst headroom for an upcoming promo. They'll sign a pilot if we ship A with billing visibility. MedFlow (pilot) needs B for compliance reporting. Both are willing to pay.
Rami: SE note: A helps, but without B customers will still get paged when spillover happens. The Console graph reduces support load.
Anya: Proposal: M1 = A (soft_headroom knob + billing_tag + API flag). M2 = thin B (read-only sparkline + CSV export). M3 = research + opt-in experiment for C. Ship M1+M2 this sprint, backfill M3. Agree?
Lucas: Implementation sketch for A: add pool fields -> soft_headroom_percent, soft_headroom_mode (elastic|strict), billing_tag. Runtime reads config at pool start. Default 0%. Migration non-breaking.
Sara: For C research we need: quality eval harness comparing base vs quantized variants, routing probe (200ms), and KV warming strategy. Spike estimate 4-6w.
Devin: Launch criteria for M1: API flag + docs, invoice tag working for billing team, staging->canary->prod deploy with p95 latency no-regressions, one-week billing delta report.
Rami: Console MVP checklist for M2: widget on pool view with sparkline of quota use last 24h, hover shows peak and headroom, export CSV. If backend lagging we can ship with mock data but flag it.
Lucas: Engineering effort estimate: M1: ~3 dev-weeks (runtime + backend + QA). M2: ~1.5 dev-weeks (frontend + small backend). M3: research 4-6 dev-weeks + rollout.
Sara: Ops asks: add alert "pool headroom consumption > 80% for >10m" -> page. Add a Canary metric "headroom-admit-failure-rate" and an automated rollback if preemption spikes > threshold. I'll own chaos test for node drains.
Anya: Action items:
- Anya: short PRD with acceptance criteria (EOD)
- Lucas: schema PR and migration plan (tomorrow)
- Sara: chaos & rollback test plan + alerts (tomorrow)
- Rami: Console wireframes for MVP (Friday)
- Devin: confirm BrightCard pilot wording and bump billing needs (today)
ops-bot: CI pipeline triggered for branch feature/soft-headroom-config. Build queued.
Rami: Billing note: include billing_tag in schema so invoice team can surface reserved bump usage.
Lucas: Example config snippet we'll include in PRD: ```
pool_name: "reserved-us-west-2"
soft_headroom_percent: 25
soft_headroom_mode: "elastic"
billing_tag: "pilot-brightcard-2026"
```
Sara: Emit metrics: "pool.soft_headroom_used", "pool.effective_capacity", "pool.preemptions". Hook to dashboards.
Anya: Final call: ship M1 + thin M2 this sprint, defer C to research. If no objections Ill write the PRD and schedule canary tomorrow.
Lucas: +1
Sara: +1
Rami: +1
Devin: :rocket:
Anya: Thanks all. I'll post PRD link when ready.
